conversation_recent.text: Just ran your calculator. I'm getting quotes from a few companies right now. Who has the cheapest price?
Code varies by street, so we won't put a number on it without measuring. I have tomorrow at 12 or 12:30 open.
My wife and I are busy tomorrow. Can I send you the measurements I have from the other companies?
No problem at all. Would Saturday at 12 or 12:30 work better instead?
Tomorrow is Saturday. Today is Friday. We're busy Saturday, I already said that. And I don't have time to sit through a long presentation.
